subject: dsa
title: Sum of Two Integers
summary: Add without +. XOR sums the bits while ignoring carries; AND then a left shift collects the carries. Repeat until no carry remains.
problem: Compute the sum of two integers a and b without using the + or - operators.

steps.caption: Add 2 and 3 using only bitwise ops. XOR sums the bits without carrying; AND shifted left gives the carry. Start with a = 2 = 0010.
a = 2 = 0010 and b = 3 = 0011. Here is b laid out as 4 bits.
XOR gives the sum without carry: 0010 ^ 0011 = 0001. Bits that differ become 1.
Carry = (a AND b) << 1: 0010 & 0011 = 0010, shifted left = 0100. Matching 1-bits carry to the next column.
Now a = 0001 and b = 0100. XOR again: 0001 ^ 0100 = 0101. Combine the partial sum and the carry.
Carry = (0001 & 0100) << 1 = 0000. No carry left, so we are done.
The result is a = 0101, which is 5.
